about_the_game:
An ASCII incremental game about a miner digging deeper and deeper into a mine while facing massive hordes of enemies.

Set off on a dangerous journey underground. Carve your way through layers of the mine, find resources, upgrade your equipment, and fight increasingly powerful enemies. Every descent opens up new ways to develop your character and create unique builds.

Game features:

• ASCII graphics — an atmospheric minimalist style inspired by classic roguelike games.
• 20+ enemy types — from weak creatures to dangerous elite foes.
• 50+ upgrades for weapons, armor, and tools.
• Character progression — improve your stats and unlock new possibilities.
• Random skills — every run offers new combinations.
• Endless builds — combine skills and upgrades to create your own playstyle.
• Massive enemy hordes — survive waves of creatures that keep getting stronger.
• Deep mine — dig deeper and try to reach the very end.

Dig. Upgrade. Experiment. Survive.
